task.title: P6-135 nits: dedupe degrade logs with upstream()'s, note the silent YourCopies degradation tradeoff
task.description:
From P6-135 review (2026-08-12), both trivial: (1) the per-site degrade logs in hosted.rs (search/card_summary/card_detail) print the already-generic ApiError after upstream() has logged the real sqlx cause — either drop the site logs to a shorter marker or restructure so the site log carries the DB internals the degrade_or doc comment promises. (2) card_detail's degraded state renders byte-identical to logged-out (YourCopies silently absent) — intentional, but revisit if a client-visible 'couldn't load your copies' affordance is ever wanted.

From P6-136 review (2026-08-12), same-file polish: (3) set_search_treats_wildcards_as_literal's .all() is vacuously true on zero rows — assert something non-vacuous (e.g. also assert a control term returns rows). (4) the rulings alias-capture fix (r.published_at) has no regression test, unlike its list_sets twin. (5) blank-term browse-all collapses the three ILIKE tiers to one via coalesce — harmless, but the three-tier comment should note the degenerate case. (6) pattern()/apply() rely on the implicit default LIKE escape while list_sets now spells ESCAPE '\' — unify the style.
